name: Endpoint
author: VINEYARD
summary: Host and endpoint forensic artifacts (files, processes, registry keys, services, mutexes, scheduled tasks) for DFIR and malware-behavior mapping.

name: Financial
author: VINEYARD
summary: Follow-the-money entities: cryptocurrency addresses and transactions, exchanges, and bank accounts. Public identifiers only — no keys, PANs, or credentials.

name: Geospatial
author: VINEYARD
summary: Places and physical context — locations with coordinates, postal addresses, and facilities — to anchor the 'where' of an investigation.

name: Identity
author: VINEYARD
summary: People, organizations, and the identities that connect them - personas, email addresses, phone numbers, PGP keys, and the accounts they hold on websites.

name: Infrastructure
author: VINEYARD
summary: Network-infrastructure and web OSINT entities (IPs, domains, URLs, hosts, ASNs, netblocks, DNS/WHOIS records, TLS certificates, SSH host keys, technologies, web fingerprints and tracking/ad-account identifiers) and their relationships.

name: Social Media
author: VINEYARD
summary: Platform-agnostic social media entities - accounts, posts, hashtags, groups, and media - with a platform discriminator on every entity. Attribution to a person or organization stays in the Identity pack.

name: Telegram
author: VINEYARD
summary: Telegram entities collected without joining: accounts (people and bots), broadcast channels, supergroups, and their posts. Pairs with the Telegram plugin pack.

name: Threat
author: VINEYARD
summary: Threat-intelligence entities (malware, campaigns, operations, vulnerabilities, threat actors, indicators, attack patterns, tools, detection signatures) and their relationships, aligned with STIX 2.1.
